Production code imports the reference module and runs its full allocation only for validation, discarding the result (twice the work) and calling its private _to_decimal, so validation is coupled to the reference module.
int(amount.scaleb(places)) truncates without checking the amount is a whole number of units, relying entirely on another module's validation instead of the local check main had.
The local _to_decimal is now dead code, since lines 18 and 20 call _ref._to_decimal instead, and it duplicates reference_impl.py verbatim.
